newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 8.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* United Nations Secretary General Boutros Boutros-Ghali warned the new Islamic rulers in Afghanistan the international organisation objected to their discrimination against women.
* U.S. corporations' outlays for research and development have fallen this decade, especially in basic research, as they concentrate on developing products for the market.

* Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole returned to his campaign trail, a day after a nationally televised debate with U.S. President Bill Clinton, driving across New Jersey and into New York City.
